svg.title: Direct Mail Return on Ad Spend Bands
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-mail-roas-bands; chapter number: 2; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Direct Mail Return on Ad Spend Bands; subtitle: Reported ROAS ranges for land mail campaigns and blended benchmarks; caption: Blind-offer mail ranges from 8x to 10x for new members to about 23x for a standout campaign, while Landon Bleau's mail runs about 3x against his texting.; assumptions note: Min and max are the reported band edges; where a range was reported, the typical value marks the band midpoint rather than a separately reported figure. Single-point claims use the same value for all three.; note: Attributed to Sumner Healey (R4icAmTE4WI), Landon Bleau via REtipster (Uaqe67xWZN0), and Clayton Hepler via DealMachine Podcast (HE45qWS8txg).; unit: x return on ad spend; bars: label: Landon Bleau Mail; min: 3; max: 3; typical: 3; display: About 3x; label: Hepler Blended Benchmark; min: 5; max: 10; typical: 7.5; display: 5x-10x; label: Healey New Members; min: 8; max: 10; typical: 9; display: 8x-10x; label: Healey Seasoned Members; min: 10; max: 20; typical: 15; display: 10x-20x; label: Anthony Blind-Offer Campaign; min: 23; max: 23; typical: 23; display: About 23x (14,000 letters, over $200K netted)
